description: Enterprise Codebase Context Builder, AST Signatures Analyzer, & Token Reducer for LLMs
author: Toprak Ahmet Aydoğmuş <toprakahmetileq@gmail.com>

tool_signatures.name: analyze_change_impact
tool_signatures.description: Calculates blast radius and change impact for modifying a specific function, class, or symbol. Identifies all direct and transitive dependent modules across the codebase.

tool_signatures.name: audit_codebase_quality
tool_signatures.description: Performs an AST static code smell audit and security check across workspace files. Detects missing docstrings, functions exceeding 30 lines, routines with 6+ arguments, global keyword variables (sync & async), and checks for hardcoded secret leaks.

project_root.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

file_path.description: Optional path to a specific file to audit. If empty, audits all Python files.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Optional path to a specific file to audit. If empty, audits all Python files.

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

tool_signatures.name: enforce_architecture_boundaries
tool_signatures.description: Enforces T-4 architectural boundary rules (tzero.rules.json). Verifies modular separation and detects unauthorized cross-layer imports.

tool_signatures.name: estimate_token_cost
tool_signatures.description: Calculates exact token count and estimated API cost (USD) across major LLM providers (OpenAI GPT-4o, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Groq, NVIDIA NIM, and Ollama $0) for a given text or directory.

text.description: Optional raw text to estimate. If empty, analyzes context from project_root.

project_root.description: Project directory to scan if text is empty (default: current directory).

reduction_mode.description: Reduction mode to apply when scanning project_root.

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Project directory to scan if text is empty (default: current directory).

parameters.name: reduction_mode
parameters.description: Reduction mode to apply when scanning project_root.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Optional raw text to estimate. If empty, analyzes context from project_root.

tool_signatures.name: export_agent_rules
tool_signatures.description: Generates native configuration rule files for AI coding agents: .cursorrules, .cursor/rules/*.mdc, .clinerules, and .github/copilot-instructions.md.

tool_signatures.name: find_code_duplicity
tool_signatures.description: Scans the repository to identify duplicate or copy-pasted blocks of code (6+ lines) across multiple files to identify refactoring opportunities.

project_root.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

min_lines.description: Minimum identical lines to classify as a duplicate block (default: 6).

parameters.name: min_lines
parameters.description: Minimum identical lines to classify as a duplicate block (default: 6).

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

tool_signatures.name: find_dead_code
tool_signatures.description: Finds unused, orphaned, or unreferenced functions and classes across the codebase AST. Excludes __all__, main, dunder methods, and test functions.

project_root.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

tool_signatures.name: generate_architecture_blueprint
tool_signatures.description: Generates a complete system architecture specification (ARCHITECTURE.md) including auto-generated Mermaid topology diagrams, component boundaries, and module dependency hierarchies. Supports live 3rd-party AI synthesis or local offline AST architecture analysis.

project_root.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

use_ai.description: If True, uses configured 3rd-party AI or Free AI Cloud to synthesize deep architecture analysis.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Optional model identifier override (e.g. 'deepseek-v4.1-flash', 'gpt-4o').

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

parameters.name: use_ai
parameters.description: If True, uses configured 3rd-party AI or Free AI Cloud to synthesize deep architecture analysis.

tool_signatures.name: generate_repo_map
tool_signatures.description: Generates an ultra-compressed AST symbol token map (classes, methods, functions) tailored for LLM chat prompts and extreme context window savings.

project_root.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

max_tokens.description: Maximum token budget for the repo map (default: 4000).

parameters.name: max_tokens
parameters.description: Maximum token budget for the repo map (default: 4000).

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

tool_signatures.name: get_incremental_diff_context
tool_signatures.description: Calculates hyper-compact PR git diff context (changed symbols + downstream blast radius dependents) for 98%+ token savings during code review and debugging.

tool_signatures.name: get_project_context_tree
tool_signatures.description: Scans the target project directory and builds an enterprise-grade multi-tier T-Zero hierarchical context tree (T-1 Master Architecture, T-2 Module References, T-3 AST Signatures, T-4 Agent Boundary Rules). Reduces ingestion tokens by up to 95% while maintaining 100% structural fidelity for LLMs.

project_root.description: Root directory of the repository to scan (default: current directory).

reduction_mode.description: Token reduction mode ('ultra' for AST signatures only, 'balanced' for signatures + control flow, 'none' for full source).

max_tokens.description: Maximum token budget cap for the returned context payload.

include_file_contents.description: If False, returns only the directory tree and high-level architecture overview.

parameters.name: include_file_contents
parameters.description: If False, returns only the directory tree and high-level architecture overview.

parameters.name: max_tokens
parameters.description: Maximum token budget cap for the returned context payload.

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Root directory of the repository to scan (default: current directory).

parameters.name: reduction_mode
parameters.description: Token reduction mode ('ultra' for AST signatures only, 'balanced' for signatures + control flow, 'none' for full source).

tool_signatures.name: get_smart_skeleton_context
tool_signatures.description: Focus-aware dynamic skeletonizer. Returns the full, unpruned implementation of the focus file (or specific focus symbol), surrounded by ultra-compact T-3 AST signatures for all 1st-degree outbound imports and inbound callers. Solves the 'Lost in the Middle' problem while saving 95%+ tokens.

focus_file.description: Target file path to focus on.

focus_symbol.description: Optional specific function or class name within focus_file to inspect.

project_root.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

parameters.name: focus_file
parameters.description: Target file path to focus on.

parameters.name: focus_symbol
parameters.description: Optional specific function or class name within focus_file to inspect.

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

tool_signatures.name: get_token_savings_metrics
tool_signatures.description: Computes quantitative token compression metrics, reduction percentage, and developer team financial ROI savings (USD/month).

tool_signatures.name: prune_code_snippet
tool_signatures.description: Compresses arbitrary in-memory source code or text into compact AST/interface signatures on-the-fly, returning pruned code and precise token savings percentage (80-95% reduction).

reduction_mode.description: 'ultra' for AST signatures only, 'balanced' for signatures + control flow.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Source code text to prune.

parameters.name: file_path_or_ext
parameters.description: File name or extension (e.g. 'service.ts', 'main.go', 'app.py', '.rs', '.java', '.cs').

parameters.name: reduction_mode
parameters.description: 'ultra' for AST signatures only, 'balanced' for signatures + control flow.

tool_signatures.name: query_architecture_boundaries
tool_signatures.description: Retrieves active T-4 architectural boundaries, operational constraints, security rules (100% Zero-Leak), and system conventions for AI coding agents (Cursor Composer, Claude Code, Cline, Antigravity).

project_root.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

extra_guidance.description: Optional custom rules, architecture styles, or conventions.

parameters.name: extra_guidance
parameters.description: Optional custom rules, architecture styles, or conventions.

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

tool_signatures.name: query_module_dependencies
tool_signatures.description: Analyzes import/export dependencies, module relationships, and internal vs external package dependencies across the codebase or for a specific file.

project_root.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

file_path.description: Optional relative or absolute path to a specific file to inspect. If empty, analyzes the whole workspace.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Optional relative or absolute path to a specific file to inspect. If empty, analyzes the whole workspace.

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

tool_signatures.name: rank_repository_pagerank
tool_signatures.description: Identifies the architectural backbone and most critical modules of any repository using graph-theory PageRank centrality over AST import and reference topologies. Ranks modules by inbound/outbound degree and structural criticality.

project_root.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

top_k.description: Number of top central modules to return in the ranking report (default: 15).

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Number of top central modules to return in the ranking report (default: 15).

tool_signatures.name: search_codebase_semantic
tool_signatures.description: 100% Private, local hybrid BM25 + TF-IDF semantic code search. Finds relevant code functions, classes, and snippets without leaking code to third-party embedding APIs.

tool_signatures.name: trace_symbol_call_chain
tool_signatures.description: Traces deep execution paths across the codebase AST. Recursively discovers upstream callers (who calls symbol_name) and downstream callees (what symbol_name calls) up to max_depth, rendering an execution tree and Mermaid call diagram.

symbol_name.description: Name of the function or method to trace.

project_root.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

max_depth.description: Maximum recursion depth for the call graph traversal (default: 3).

parameters.name: max_depth
parameters.description: Maximum recursion depth for the call graph traversal (default: 3).

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

parameters.name: symbol_name
parameters.description: Name of the function or method to trace.

tool_signatures.name: verify_hallucination_guard
tool_signatures.description: Eliminates AI coding hallucinations before code is written or applied. Parses proposed code and verifies all internal imports and function/method call contracts (argument counts and keyword parameter names) against known workspace AST signatures.

proposed_code.description: Python code proposed to be written or edited.

target_file.description: Optional path of the target file being modified.

project_root.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

parameters.name: proposed_code
parameters.description: Python code proposed to be written or edited.

parameters.name: target_file
parameters.description: Optional path of the target file being modified.

reduction_mode.description: 'ultra' for AST signatures only, 'balanced' for signatures + control flow.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Source code text to prune.

parameters.name: file_path_or_ext
parameters.description: File name or extension (e.g. 'service.ts', 'main.go', 'app.py', '.rs', '.java', '.cs').

parameters.name: reduction_mode
parameters.description: 'ultra' for AST signatures only, 'balanced' for signatures + control flow.

tool_signatures.name: query_architecture_boundaries
tool_signatures.description: Retrieves active T-4 architectural boundaries, operational constraints, security rules (100% Zero-Leak), and system conventions for AI coding agents (Cursor Composer, Claude Code, Cline, Antigravity).

project_root.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

extra_guidance.description: Optional custom rules, architecture styles, or conventions.

parameters.name: extra_guidance
parameters.description: Optional custom rules, architecture styles, or conventions.

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

tool_signatures.name: query_module_dependencies
tool_signatures.description: Analyzes import/export dependencies, module relationships, and internal vs external package dependencies across the codebase or for a specific file.

project_root.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

file_path.description: Optional relative or absolute path to a specific file to inspect. If empty, analyzes the whole workspace.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Optional relative or absolute path to a specific file to inspect. If empty, analyzes the whole workspace.

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

tool_signatures.name: rank_repository_pagerank
tool_signatures.description: Identifies the architectural backbone and most critical modules of any repository using graph-theory PageRank centrality over AST import and reference topologies. Ranks modules by inbound/outbound degree and structural criticality.

project_root.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

top_k.description: Number of top central modules to return in the ranking report (default: 15).

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Number of top central modules to return in the ranking report (default: 15).

tool_signatures.name: search_codebase_semantic
tool_signatures.description: 100% Private, local hybrid BM25 + TF-IDF semantic code search. Finds relevant code functions, classes, and snippets without leaking code to third-party embedding APIs.

tool_signatures.name: trace_symbol_call_chain
tool_signatures.description: Traces deep execution paths across the codebase AST. Recursively discovers upstream callers (who calls symbol_name) and downstream callees (what symbol_name calls) up to max_depth, rendering an execution tree and Mermaid call diagram.

symbol_name.description: Name of the function or method to trace.

project_root.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

max_depth.description: Maximum recursion depth for the call graph traversal (default: 3).

parameters.name: max_depth
parameters.description: Maximum recursion depth for the call graph traversal (default: 3).

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

parameters.name: symbol_name
parameters.description: Name of the function or method to trace.

tool_signatures.name: verify_hallucination_guard
tool_signatures.description: Eliminates AI coding hallucinations before code is written or applied. Parses proposed code and verifies all internal imports and function/method call contracts (argument counts and keyword parameter names) against known workspace AST signatures.

proposed_code.description: Python code proposed to be written or edited.

target_file.description: Optional path of the target file being modified.

project_root.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

parameters.name: project_root
parameters.description: Root directory of the repository (default: current directory).

parameters.name: proposed_code
parameters.description: Python code proposed to be written or edited.

parameters.name: target_file
parameters.description: Optional path of the target file being modified.

tool_signatures.name: verify_zero_leak_security
tool_signatures.description: 100% Zero-Leak security scanner. Analyzes a file, code snippet, or repository workspace for hardcoded API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, NVIDIA, Gemini, HuggingFace, GitHub), private keys, JWT tokens, and cloud secrets (100% private, 0 external network calls, $0 cost).
